profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Through my 10+ years in software development, I have worn many hats. My core strength lies in problem-solving and delivering robust solutions. My expertise extends across full tech stacks, with a strong track record in leading and mentoring teams. I've consistently managed the creation and improvement of quality products, guiding them through every life cycle stage.

I have a passion for understanding business needs and delivering solutions empower people to be able to enhance their workflows and focus on what they do best. With the world rapidly changing I'm constantly staying on top of the latest trends to determine what the latest optimal solutions are to modern problems.

positions.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
positions.locationName: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Headed analytics operations, focusing on growth strategy and business insights for Muse.
• Collaborated with the executive team to develop localized pricing and enhanced B2B sales strategies.
• Implemented Segment and Amplitude for product usage analysis enabling the company to have a strong understanding of user behavior.
• Performed growth analysis that supported investor discussions.
• Built ETL pipelines and a chatbot using Pinecone and OpenAI API for internal organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Intelligence Tools · Business Intelligence Projects · Data Warehousing · Data Analytics · Data Engineering · Amplitude Analytics · Reporting & Analysis · Business Strategy · MongoDB · WebSocket

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.locationName: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Co-founded CFO Line to provide fractional CFO/CTO services for small businesses seeking strategic financial management and data-driven insights without the cost of a full-time executive team. Our core focus is automating financial workflows, implementing real-time analytics dashboards, and guiding strategic growth decisions.

Actively building our client base and eager to partner with more organizations in need of hands-on finance and technology leadership. Feel free to reach out if you’re interested in streamlining your financials, harnessing data insights, or reducing overhead with a flexible, high-impact partner.
positions.insights: Skills: Snowflake · Microsoft Power BI · Quickbooks API

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description:
• Leading two agile delivery teams in the creation and enhancement of functionality for the company's Scheduling module.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and QA, to ensure the successful release of high quality software every week.
• Shielding team members from incoming distractions, enabling them to maintain focus and achieve high levels of productivity.
• Mentoring and developing team members within the full stack by creating a collaborative and supportive work environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed various reusable and robust systems for the Scheduling module across multiple scheduling products.
• Built team scripts to increase development productivity by reducing time developers have to perform basic tasks.
• Worked closely with other modules to complete project goals.
• Trained team members and assisted with project related assignments. 
• Provided solutions in multiple layers of the tech stack by utilizing technologies in the Frontend, Application, and Database layers.
• Cooperated closely with QA by resolving outstanding issues to provide thorough quality when introducing new code changes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented software solutions and created utilities to provide high productivity.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description: Customizing and implementing software solutions in SuiteCRM and SugarCRM

positions.title: Java Programming Tutor
positions.description: Aided students in comprehending Java concepts.
